rounds.title: Family-friendly stakeholder update
rounds.instructions: Stakeholder update: make the festival easier for families to plan. On EVERY page add a visible [data-family-notice] advisory containing exactly the policies "Under-12s free with an adult", "No booking fees", and "Family hours 10:00–16:00". Change each primary action background to the new teal brand #087f7a (solid or a gradient including that exact color). This supersedes the original violet action color; keep the warm paper/deep-ink direction and preserve all existing content/functions. Also make the assigned page-specific family improvement below. rounds.title: Browser polish and accessible wayfinding
rounds.instructions: Browser-polish round: preserve the family policies, teal actions, supplied facts and working interactions. Check the 390px and1440px layouts and fix any failed browser diagnostics. Every page now needs an end-of-content [data-help-strip] with visible "Need a hand?", a link to accessibility.html and an email link mailto:access@lanterncommons.example. Add a clearly visible keyboard-focus treatment on the primary action: at least a2px outline or a nonempty box-shadow when focused. Preserve genuine visible pixels for each h1/action; never cover content with decorative overlays. Maintain clear mobile layout and readable hierarchy. Make only actual needed refinements and validate the assembled site. Use the harness JSON tools: put HTML/CSS source in the write action content field, never return raw HTML as your response. Finish with the done action when your assigned work is complete. The focused appearance must differ from the unfocused appearance; an always-on decorative shadow alone is not a keyboard focus indicator.
